$comment: TEMPLATE FILL-IN — copy to smoke-triage.config.json and COMMIT it. The merge gate for the nightly smoke-triage routine (scripts/smoke-triage-scope.mjs). REQUIRED, and deliberately without defaults: with no valid policy the gate answers UNDECIDABLE and the routine keeps its fix as a draft PR. testSurface = the ONLY paths the routine may merge by itself (an allow-list; everything else is app code). assertionCalls = every assertion function your specs call, including your own helpers — a deleted call to an unlisted helper would go unnoticed.

testSurface.why: the Playwright specs and their helpers — the smoke itself
projects, timeouts, workers — how the smoke runs
